geometry.type: idealized straight carotid segment with smooth super-Gaussian focal stenosis
geometry.stenosis_definition: fractional diameter reduction relative to nominal diameter

velocity.method: analytic reduced-order axisymmetric field with exact sectional flux construction, continuity-derived radial component, zero-area-mean post-stenotic profile disturbance, and bounded axisymmetric swirl

vorticity.method: finite-difference numerical curl of implemented reduced-order velocity field

pressure.method: reduced-order convective/Bernoulli term plus explicit configured downstream loss term
pressure.warning: not a pressure field from a CFD pressure solve and not clinically validated

wall_shear.method: magnitude from analytic reduced-order wall velocity gradients
wall_shear.warning: belongs only to the demonstration model
